CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Autumn-2016 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Autumn-2016 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 600 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 2 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: March 2016 to April 2016). These surveys captured 13 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 7 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 590 cards across 52 sites, with 1.7% showing evidence of mouse activity (10 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 212 transects across 52 sites (survey period: March 2016 to May 2016), detecting active burrows in 18.9% of transects (total: 87 active burrows).
